mainEntity.name: Is hosting.com the same as A2 Hosting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A2 Hosting announced on its own blog in April 2025 that it is now hosting.com.
For the first term, yes: hosting.com Starter is $1.49 a month on a 12-month plan, and Hostinger Premium is $1.99 a month on a 48-month plan. At renewal, Hostinger is lower.

mainEntity.name: Which has the lower renewal price?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hostinger Premium renews at $10.99 a month. hosting.com Starter renews at $13.99 a month, as each host lists on its own page.

mainEntity.name: Do both hosts list AI features?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Both list an AI website builder, an AI assistant and an MCP server. We have not tested them.

mainEntity.name: Do both offer a money-back guarantee?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both list a 30-day money-back guarantee on their pages.

mainEntity.name: Which host should I pick for a new WordPress site?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pick the one that fits how long you plan to stay. hosting.com suits a short first term, and Hostinger suits a long one.
